triage.summary: KubeSolo runtime is unhealthy due to a missing containerd socket file, causing the apiserver to fail with context deadline exceeded errors.
triage.cause: The containerd socket at /var/lib/kubesolo/containerd/containerd.sock does not exist, indicating the runtime failed to start or was killed before the socket was created. This matches the 'runtime' component failure in the triage knowledge.
